# Copilot / VS Code agent notes

Oracle CPQ MCP behavior is **not** defined here.

1. Connect the Oracle CPQ MCP server (see `.vscode/mcp.json.example`).
2. Follow root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): **MCP server instructions are authoritative** for refined prompts, turn metrics, document templates, local data, and exports.
3. Tool authoring: [`docs/STANDARDS.md`](../docs/STANDARDS.md).

`.cursor/rules/` is Cursor-only and is not required for Copilot.
